# Generate motif similarity matrix

```{r}
# Define conditions
homer_files <- c(
    TLR7_iHPC = "TLR7-iHPC/knownResults.txt", 
    TLR7_Ly6CMon = "TLR7-Ly6CMon/knownResults.txt", 
    WT_Ly6CMon = "WT-Ly6CMon/knownResults.txt"
    )
```

```{r}
# Define function to import knownResults.txt
read_homer <- function(path, condition) {
  raw_lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  header_line <- raw_lines[1]
  target_total <- as.numeric(
    sub(".*# of Target Sequences with Motif\\(of ([0-9]+)\\).*", "\\1", header_line)
  )
  bg_total <- as.numeric(
    sub(".*# of Background Sequences with Motif\\(of ([0-9]+)\\).*", "\\1", header_line)
  )
  txt <- paste(raw_lines, collapse = "\n")
  txt <- stringi::stri_replace_all_regex(txt, "\\p{Zs}+", " ")
  txt <- gsub("[ \t]+", "\t", txt)
  df <- readr::read_delim(I(txt), delim = "\t", comment = "#",
                          col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8) %>%
    rename(
      `Motif Name`        = 1,
      `P-value`           = 2,
      `Log P-value`       = 3,
      `q-value`           = 4,
      n_target_with_motif = 5,
      n_bg_with_motif     = 6
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Condition    = condition,
      Motif        = sub("/.*", "", `Motif Name`),
      target_total = target_total,
      bg_total     = bg_total
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Condition, Motif,
      pvalue  = `P-value`,
      logP    = `Log P-value`,
      qvalue  = `q-value`,
      n_target_with_motif,
      n_bg_with_motif,
      target_total,
      bg_total
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      MotifID = Motif %>%
        str_replace("/.*$", "") %>%
        str_replace("\\(.*$", "") %>%
        str_trim()
    )
}
# Import knownResults.txt for each condition
knownResults_cellConsensus_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(.x = homer_files, .f = ~ read_homer(path = .x, condition = .y))
#sig_knownResults_cellConsensus_df <- knownResults_cellConsensus_df %>%
#  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05 & pvalue <= 1e-20)
```

Gather PWMs for motifs in motif_union
```{r}
# Collect candidate motif files, filter any empty ones
known_dirs <- tibble(
  Condition = names(homer_files),
  known_dir = file.path(dirname(homer_files), "knownResults")
) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(dir.exists(known_dir))
candidate_tbl <- known_dirs %>%
  mutate(paths = map(known_dir, ~ list.files(.x, pattern = "\\.motif$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))) %>%
  unnest(paths) %>%
  distinct(Condition, paths) %>%
  rename(path = paths)
candidate_motif_files <- unique(candidate_tbl$path)
candidate_motif_files <- unique(unlist(lapply(file.path(dirname(homer_files), "knownResults"), function(d) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(character(0))
  list.files(d, pattern = "\\.motif$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
}), use.names = FALSE))
fi <- file.info(candidate_motif_files)
candidate_motif_files <- candidate_motif_files[!fi$isdir & fi$size > 0]
# Get name of each motif by reading first line
get_header_name <- function(p) {
  con <- file(p, open = "r")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  # Read the first non-empty line (header)
  line <- ""
  repeat {
    line <- readLines(con, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
    if (length(line) == 0 || nzchar(line)) break
  }
  if (length(line) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  # --- Primary path: regex extraction ---
  # Pattern: 
  #   ^>\s*         : start, '>' and optional spaces
  #   [^\t]+        : first field (motif sequence) up to TAB
  #   \t\s*         : TAB + optional spaces
  #   ([^/\t]+)     : CAPTURE second field up to first '/' or TAB
  rx <- "^>\\s*[^\\t]+\\t\\s*([^/\\t]+)"
  m <- regexec(rx, line, perl = TRUE)
  cap <- regmatches(line, m)
  if (length(cap) > 0 && length(cap[[1]]) >= 2) {
    id <- trimws(cap[[1]][2])
    if (nzchar(id)) return(id)
  }
  # --- Fallback path: split by TAB, then split field 2 at '/' ---
  parts <- strsplit(line, "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) >= 2) {
    id2 <- trimws(strsplit(parts[2], "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1])
    if (!is.na(id2) && nzchar(id2)) return(id2)
  }
  # If all else fails
  NA_character_
}
ids <- lapply(candidate_motif_files, get_header_name)
ids <- unlist(ids, use.names = FALSE)
# Build a motif ID -> paths map (handle duplicates by keeping first file)
idx_df <- data.frame(id = ids, path = candidate_motif_files, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  subset(!is.na(id) & nzchar(id))
idx_df <- idx_df[!duplicated(idx_df$id), , drop = FALSE]
# Filter to motifs in Natalie's list
motifs_needed_df <- read.csv("CellTypeConsensus_TF_motifsNeeded.csv", header = FALSE)
colnames(motifs_needed_df)[1] <- "motif_name"
motifs_needed_df$motif_name <- sub("/.*", "", motifs_needed_df$motif_name)
motifs_needed <- as.character(motifs_needed_df$motif_name)
needed_paths <- idx_df$path[match(motifs_needed, idx_df$id)]
has_path <- !is.na(needed_paths)
motifs_needed <- motifs_needed[has_path]
needed_paths  <- needed_paths[has_path]
# Read PWMs of motifs
read_one <- function(p) {
  tryCatch(
    universalmotif::read_homer(p),
    error = function(e) {
      # fallback to autodetect in case the file isn't strict HOMER
      tryCatch(universalmotif::read_motifs(p, autodetect = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  )
}
motifs_list_of_lists <- lapply(needed_paths, read_one)
motifs_all <- unlist(motifs_list_of_lists, recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE)
motifs_all <- Filter(Negate(is.null), motifs_all)
length(motifs_all)
```

Filter out low information motifs (very low complexity/degenerate with nearly uniform A/C/G/T columns)
```{r}
motif_ic <- vapply(
  motifs_all,
  function(m) sum(m@icscore, na.rm = TRUE),
  numeric(1)
)
min_ic <- 8
motifs_filt <- motifs_all[motif_ic >= min_ic]
length(motifs_all) # 116
length(motifs_filt) # 111
names(motifs_filt) <- vapply(
  motifs_filt,
  function(m) paste0(m@name, "(", m@family, ")"),
  character(1)
)
motifs_filt <- lapply(motifs_filt, function(m) {
  m@name <- paste0(m@name, "(", m@family, ")")
  m
})
low_ic_motifs <- Filter(function(x) x@icscore < min_ic, motifs_all)
```

Compute similarity dendrogram and cluster
```{r}
sim_mat  <- compare_motifs(motifs_filt, method = "PCC", min.overlap = 5)
dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - sim_mat)
row_clust <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "average")
cluster_motifs <- names(motifs_filt)
write.csv(sim_mat, "CellTypeConsensus_TFmotif_SimilarityMatrix.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

Plot similarity heatmap ordered by dendrogram
```{r}
col_fun_sim <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "yellow", "red"))
#pdf(file = "CellTypeConsensus_TFmotif_heatmap.pdf", width = 28, height = 25)
Heatmap(
    sim_mat,
    name = "Similarity\n(Pearson correlation\ncoefficient)",
    col = col_fun_sim,
    cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(row_clust),
    cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(row_clust),
    row_names_side = "left",
    column_names_side = "top",
    show_row_dend = TRUE,
    show_column_dend = TRUE,
    rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = NA)
)
#dev.off()
```

# Build all motifs heatmap for TLR7 iHPC vs. Ly6C monocytes integrated with RNAseq data, no IRF5 ChIP overlap

Assign groups of similar known motifs per Natalie's motif lists + aggregate counts
```{r}
motif_group_defin_df <- read.csv("05112026_motifCategories.csv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Build list of motif groups
motif_groups <- setNames(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(motif_group_defin_df)), function(i) {
    row_vals <- as.character(motif_group_defin_df[i, ])
    row_vals <- row_vals[row_vals != ""]  # remove empty cells if any
    row_vals[-1]  # everything after first column
  }),
  motif_group_defin_df[[1]]  # first column as names
)

# Build a motif to group mapping data frame
motif_group_df <- stack(motif_groups) %>%
  rename(Motif = values, RepMotif = ind) %>%
  mutate(
    RepMotif   = as.character(RepMotif),
    MotifGroup = paste0("Group_", RepMotif)
  )
```

Import HOMER output files
```{r}
# Define conditions
homer_files_diffPeaks_rnaAtac <- c(
  iHPC = "TLR7-iHPC_RNA_ATAC_integrated/knownResults.txt", 
  Ly6CMon = "TLR7-Ly6CMon_RNA_ATAC_integrated/knownResults.txt" 
  )
# Import knownResults.txt for each condition
knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(.x = homer_files_diffPeaks_rnaAtac, .f = ~ read_homer(path = .x, condition = .y))
sig_knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_df <- knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05)
```

Aggregate counts across motif groups per replicate, then compute log2FC for % of motifs in target over background
```{r}
agg_diffPeaks_motif_df <- sig_knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_df %>%
  inner_join(motif_group_df, by = "Motif") %>%
  group_by(Condition, MotifGroup, RepMotif,
           target_total, bg_total) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    sum_n_target = sum(n_target_with_motif, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_n_bg     = sum(n_bg_with_motif,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Condition, MotifGroup, RepMotif) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    sum_n_target = sum(sum_n_target),
    sum_n_bg     = sum(sum_n_bg),
    target_total = dplyr::first(target_total),
    bg_total     = dplyr::first(bg_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_target = sum_n_target / target_total,
    pct_bg     = sum_n_bg     / bg_total,
    log2FC     = log2((pct_target + 1e-6) / (pct_bg + 1e-6))
  )
```

Build log2FC matrix and plot heatmap
```{r}
# Pivot to matrix (rows = representative motif label, cols = condition)
log2fc_mat_diffPeaks <- agg_diffPeaks_motif_df %>%
  dplyr::select(RepMotif, Condition, log2FC) %>%
  mutate(Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition,
    "iHPC"      = "More accessible in iHPCs",
    "Ly6CMon"   = "More accessible in TLR7 monocytes"
  )) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("RepMotif") %>%
  as.matrix()
# Color scale
max_fc_diffPeaks <- max(abs(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_diffPeaks <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(0, max_fc_diffPeaks, length.out = 100),
  magma(100)
)
# Remove rows that would break clustering (all-NA)
giveNAs_diffPeaks  <- which(is.na(as.matrix(dist(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks))), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(giveNAs_diffPeaks) > 0) {
  tab      <- sort(table(c(giveNAs_diffPeaks)), decreasing = TRUE)
  checkNA  <- sapply(seq_along(tab), function(i)
    sum(is.na(as.matrix(dist(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks[-as.numeric(names(tab[1:i])), ])))))
  rmv      <- names(tab)[1:min(which(checkNA == 0))]
  log2fc_mat_diffPeaks <- log2fc_mat_diffPeaks[-as.numeric(rmv), ]
}
#pdf(file = "homer_heatmaps/Ly6CMoniHPC_diffPeaks_rnaAtacIntegrated_heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
Heatmap(
  log2fc_mat_diffPeaks,
  name = "log2(% target /\n% background)",
  column_title  = "Peak motif enrichment",
  col = col_fun_diffPeaks,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 30,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  na_col = "grey90"
)
#dev.off()
```

# TLR7 monocytes vs iHPC differential peaks integrated with RNAseq with IRF5 ChIP overlap

Import HOMER output files
```{r}
# Define conditions
homer_files_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5 <- c(
  iHPC = "TLR7-iHPC_RNA_ATAC_integrated/irf5_bound/knownResults.txt", 
  Ly6CMon = "TLR7-Ly6CMon_RNA_ATAC_integrated/irf5_bound/knownResults.txt" 
  )
# Import knownResults.txt for each condition
knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(.x = homer_files_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5, .f = ~ read_homer(path = .x, condition = .y))
sig_knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_df <- knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05)
```

Aggregate counts across IRF motif groups
```{r}
# Aggregate counts across motif groups, then compute log2FC for % of motifs in target over background
agg_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_motif_df <- sig_knownResults_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_df %>%
  inner_join(irf_motif_group_df, by = "Motif") %>%
  group_by(Condition, MotifGroup, RepMotif,
           target_total, bg_total) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    sum_n_target = sum(n_target_with_motif, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_n_bg     = sum(n_bg_with_motif,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Condition, MotifGroup, RepMotif) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    sum_n_target = sum(sum_n_target),
    sum_n_bg     = sum(sum_n_bg),
    target_total = dplyr::first(target_total),
    bg_total     = dplyr::first(bg_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_target = sum_n_target / target_total,
    pct_bg     = sum_n_bg     / bg_total,
    log2FC     = log2((pct_target + 1e-6) / (pct_bg + 1e-6))
  )
```

Build log2FC matrix and plot
```{r}
# Pivot to matrix (rows = representative motif label, cols = condition)
log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5 <- agg_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5_motif_df %>%
  dplyr::select(RepMotif, Condition, log2FC) %>%
  mutate(Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition,
    "iHPC"      = "More accessible in iHPCs",
    "Ly6CMon"   = "More accessible in TLR7 monocytes"
  )) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("RepMotif") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Color scale
max_fc_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5 <- max(abs(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5 <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(0, max_fc_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5, length.out = 100),
  magma(100)
)

# Remove rows that would break clustering (all-NA)
giveNAs_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5  <- which(is.na(as.matrix(dist(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5))), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(giveNAs_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5) > 0) {
  tab      <- sort(table(c(giveNAs_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5)), decreasing = TRUE)
  checkNA  <- sapply(seq_along(tab), function(i)
    sum(is.na(as.matrix(dist(log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5[-as.numeric(names(tab[1:i])), ])))))
  rmv      <- names(tab)[1:min(which(checkNA == 0))]
  log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5 <- log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5[-as.numeric(rmv), ]
}
#pdf(file = "homer_heatmaps/Ly6CMoniHPC_diffPeaks_rnaAtacIntegrated_IRF5bound_IRF_heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
Heatmap(
  log2fc_mat_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5,
  name = "log2(% target /\n% background)",
  column_title  = "Peak motif enrichment (IRF5-bound sites)",
  col = col_fun_diffPeaks_rnaAtac_IRF5,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 30,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  na_col = "grey90"
)
#dev.off()
```
